create.name: Angaangaq Angakkorsuaq
create.bio:
Angaangaq Angakkorsuaq, widely known simply as Angaangaq or Uncle, is a Kalaallit shaman, healer and storyteller from Greenland. He comes from a family of traditional healers and was prepared for the role from childhood, above all by his grandmother Aanakasaa. His mother gave him the task that still shapes his work: to thaw what has frozen in people's hearts, by which he means closing the gap between the mind and the heart.

His teaching draws on the oral traditions of the Greenlandic people. He works in circles, with stories and chants, the qilaut wind drum and smoke ceremonies, and he leads traditional sweat lodges. Alongside seminars and one-to-one sessions he gives talks on climate, the environment and indigenous concerns, and he has spoken at the United Nations, at scientific meetings and at a Vatican conference on religion and sustainable development; his travels have taken him to more than seventy countries. He teaches in English, mostly in Europe and the United States, and offers a three-year programme in Europe. His organisation, IceWisdom, is registered in Fort Myers, Florida, and supports a healing centre in Greenland named after his grandmother.

courses.title: Meet Angaangaq | Bonn, Germany
courses.description: An evening introduction in Bonn to his teachings and way of working, centred on moving from thinking into feeling and the heart.

courses.title: Intensive Seminar: Strong in Stormy Times | Bonn, Germany
courses.description: A two-day seminar in Bonn held in a circle, with stories, chants and ceremony from the Greenlandic tradition, on finding steadiness in difficult times.

courses.title: Intensive Seminar with Sweat Lodge | Mainhardt near Stuttgart, Germany
courses.description: A weekend near Stuttgart in which participants prepare for, build and take part in a traditional sweat lodge ceremony with Angaangaq, then reflect together in a closing circle.

courses.title: Individual Session with Angaangaq
courses.description: One-to-one sessions, online or in person in Germany, by appointment. People may bring any question about their life, and he works with them in his own traditional way.
